title: Tamsin and the Hymn
author: B. M. Lockridge
blurb: Mirabel Sterling, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
